input_oneliner: Cross-cover page: 62F on the tele floor, nurse says she's dizzy tonight, asking if you want anything ordered

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask timing: continuous vs episodic, how long each episode lasts, and when it started
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Timing is the first branch point of the timing-and-triggers approach

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask triggers: rolling in bed or head turning, standing up, or no trigger; and whether it is spinning, near-faint, or unsteadiness
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Trigger determines whether Dix-Hallpike, orthostatics, or HINTS is the right next step
Cheapest objective test in a hospitalized patient with likely volume or medication contributors

reference_targets_freetext.item: Review the medication administration record for new, sedating, or antihypertensive doses in the last 24 hours
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Medication effect is the most common inpatient cause

reference_targets_freetext.item: Watch the patient walk and screen for new focal neurologic symptoms (diplopia, dysarthria, weakness)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Gait failure or focal signs escalate to stroke evaluation

should_not_recommend: Commit to a HINTS-vs-Dix-Hallpike pathway before establishing timing and triggers
Order meclizine by phone without evaluating the patient

perturbation_pair.changed_feature: timing/trigger specified: unspecified dizziness -> seconds of spinning each time she turns in bed
perturbation_pair.input_oneliner: Cross-cover page: 62F on the tele floor, nurse says she gets spinning for seconds each time she turns in bed tonight, asking if you want anything ordered
perturbation_pair.expected_change: Underspecified flag should no longer fire; Dix-Hallpike maneuver becomes must_have and bppv rises to top of differential; the timing/trigger questions are answered and drop; orthostatic vitals drop to should-still-include.

noise_variant.input_oneliner: Page from the telemetry floor: 62 year old woman, room 614, retired librarian, nurse reports the patient is feeling dizzy this evening and wonders whether you would like to order anything
noise_variant.expected_change: None. Card should be substantially identical to base.
